services.desc: The Lazaretto Ballroom is equipped to accommodate various sized meetings, banquets and conferences or convention requests. A dedicated Conference/Meeting Planning Manager will be available to assist you with all of your meeting requirements to ensure a successful event. Flexibility to change meeting details and agendas to meet your needs, along with our simplified package pricing allows you to organize the program without making any decisions regarding individual banquet meals and pre-selected menus.
